tagline: 美能达旁轴相机，1955 年发布
description: 美能达于1955年推出的旁轴相机。配备Chiyoko Rokkor 1:3.5/45mm (4 elements in 3 groups like a Tessar), or Chiyoko Rokkor 1:2.8/45mm (5 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度leaf shutter, Citizen MVX with speeds B, 1sec to 1/400sec and M/F/X flash sync, or Optiper MVL with speeds B, 1sec to 1/500sec and M/X sync, plus B, both variants with self-timer。使用35mm。

specs.镜头: Chiyoko Rokkor 1:3.5/45mm (4 elements in 3 groups like a Tessar), or Chiyoko Rokkor 1:2.8/45mm (5 elements in 3 groups)
specs.快门: leaf shutter, Citizen MVX with speeds B, 1sec to 1/400sec and M/F/X flash sync, or Optiper MVL with speeds B, 1sec to 1/500sec and M/X sync, plus B, both variants with self-timer
specs.取景器: reverse Galilean bright frame finder with superimposed coupled rangefinder and mechanical parallax correction
specs.英文简介: The Minolta A-2 was launched by Chiyoda Kōgaku Seikō in 1955 as the advanced variant of the Minolta A rangefinder camera for 35mm film.
